description: Save a viewport screenshot and return the file path (image enters context only if the file is read). Defaults to CSS pixels on HiDPI displays (env CDPILOT_SHOT_SCALE=device keeps device pixels). A w x h image costs ceil(w/28)*ceil(h/28) vision tokens: crop with element to cut pixels; format and quality change only file size.

element.description: CSS selector to crop to element bounding box

quality.description: JPEG quality 1-100 (.jpg only; default 80): file size only, same vision tokens

name: browser_screenshot
